title: The Hunters Guild: Red Hood
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A dark fantasy retelling of Little Red Riding Hood in which hunters battle werewolves to the death. The series grew out of a prize-winning Weekly Shonen Jump one-shot and ran three volumes before ending. Database tags list hunters, a guild, witches, age transformation and orphaned characters.
life_message: Courage and determination in protecting others from monsters define a hunter's life.
